interpretation: Finite-window cumulative time including due but uninserted target trips. Incomplete trips are right-censored; completed-only mean is secondary.
spatial_time_method: End-of-step rectangular integration; peak core/periphery may differ by <= step boundary terms from exact trip elapsed time.
queue_population: All cohorts; stopped-speed threshold <0.1 m/s is a count proxy, not contiguous physical queue length.
